verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a full Platform CLI (Node.js, OAuth1/2, webhooks, polling triggers, HTTP middleware) for building custom integrations and publishing to the App Directory, plus a Visual Builder alternative and an SDK (@zapier/zapier-sdk) with quickstart docs. This directly satisfies a documented developer platform/SDK/CLI for building custom connectors. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the CLI workflow beyond vendor docs.
